text:
fiona (docs): quick alert from analytics: ~22 404s this morning coming from outbound links that point to old permalinks after the nav rename. most are guides that we renamed during the restructure.
samir (eng): can you share an example URL?
fiona (docs): e.g. https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/deploying -> we renamed to /guides/deploy/deploying but some customers still link to the old path.
marco (ops): we should add redirects for the common rename patterns. do we have the old->new mapping anywhere?
fiona (docs): i ran `rg "guides/deploying|guides/ops-deploy" -n public | sort | uniq` and pulled ~18 suspect entries from our internal link tracker.
samir (eng): short-term: add redirect rules in docusaurus `static/_redirects` or the hosting config. example rule: `/guides/deploying  /guides/deploy/deploying  301`
marco (ops): Netlify supports `_redirects` file. i'll stage a patch that adds wildcard mappings for the `guides/*` renames.
fiona (docs): also important: update external link owners where possible. i can open a tiny doc explaining the changes and include canonical links so partners can update.
search-bot: Found 22 hits in external refs pointing to deprecated guides paths. Report: https://internal/reports/docs-redirects-2145.csv
samir (eng): long-term: we should maintain a redirects manifest in the repo and a small CI check that ensures any renamed doc gets an entry. i can sketch a pre-merge hook that fails PRs that delete/rename files without adding a mapping.
fiona (docs): agree. for now can we prioritize the top-10 404s from the analytics export? that should get us under the alert threshold.
marco (ops): prioritizing now. i'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/529 with `_redirects` changes + short smoke test in CI to curl old path and expect 301. assigning @samir for review.
ci-bot: linkcheck job queued on branch docs/redirects-hotfix (job #610).
samir (eng): reviewing, added a small validate script to ensure no redirect loops: `python -c "import requests;print(requests.head('https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/deploying').status_code)"`
fiona (docs): once merged, i'll message the top external link owners and update the public changelog. thanks all. :pray:
